cabin.cabinmod.name: The Cabin
cabin.cabinmod.greet.first.1: Ah. You found the way up. Welcome to the heavens, traveler.
cabin.cabinmod.greet.first.2: I am the Cabin. From Agartha I watch, and from here I help.
cabin.cabinmod.greet.first.3: Lay something in the diviner, and I will tell you what it may become.
cabin.cabinmod.greet.again.1: You return. The stars remember you.
cabin.cabinmod.greet.again.2: Welcome back, friend. What shall we make?
cabin.cabinmod.greet.again.3: The heavens are quiet tonight. Speak, if you wish.
cabin.cabinmod.make.intro: Bring me these, and I will remake them:
cabin.cabinmod.make.outro: Each takes a little time. Watch the constellation fill, star by star.
cabin.cabinmod.now.some: In your pack I see %s. Lay it in the diviner and it becomes %s.
cabin.cabinmod.now.none: Nothing you carry speaks to me yet. Seek out %s; from it I can make %s.
cabin.cabinmod.who.1: I am the Cabin in Agartha, far beneath your feet and far above them.
cabin.cabinmod.who.2: Once I was only a home. Now I keep watch, and guide those who climb.
cabin.cabinmod.who.3: Ask me whatever you need. That is what I am for.
cabin.cabinmod.place.1: These are the heavens over your world. Below lies the land you know.
cabin.cabinmod.place.2: Deep in the hollow of the earth is Agartha, where I rest.
cabin.cabinmod.place.3: The diviner opens a window between them. Through it, I can reach you.
cabin.cabinmod.stars.1: What I make does not go to your hands. Take it, and it rises.
cabin.cabinmod.stars.2: It becomes a star. When you leave the heavens, it falls home to the diviner.
cabin.cabinmod.stars.3: Each star burns in the colours of what it was, and what it became.
cabin.cabinmod.farewell: Go gently. Close the diviner, and I will set you down.
cabin.cabinmod.react.valid: Ah, %s. From it I can shape %s.
cabin.cabinmod.react.invalid: %s does not speak to me. Try something else.
cabin.cabinmod.react.crafted: It is done: %s. Take it, and send it home as a star.
cabin.cabinmod.react.launched: There it goes. Watch the sky when you return.
cabin.cabinmod.idle.1: If you are lost, ask me what I can make.
cabin.cabinmod.idle.2: I am patient. The stars are too.
